note: Names and descriptions are the official in-game text as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide; each one names the source its facts come from. Methods marked unconfirmed are not settled fact anywhere yet.

gtazone.name: GTA-Zone — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

sixshore.name: SixShore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands when the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no shortcut: it is the sum of the story, the side questlines, the activities and the collectibles in this guide. Follow the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist — and this unlocks last.
steps: Finish the 5 story chapters
Complete the 6 side-character questlines
Work through the 100% checklist (A Long Road) last — it is the longest grind

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which appears only after the story. It asks for 35 requirements in three groups — Story & Tasks, Exploration & Activities, Discovery — but most only need a part of the total, so it is closer to 60% true completion. The no-slack items are the choke points: all robberies, 33 underwater discoveries, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone time trials and Bret's 15 Target Decks.
steps: Finish the story first — the checklist only appears after the credits
Open the Checklist tab in this guide and work group by group
Leave the no-slack items (all robberies, 33 underwater discoveries, 42 range golds, 42 drone trials, 15 Target Decks) for focused sessions

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the last story mission and unlocks automatically when you finish it — it cannot be missed.
steps: Play through the story to its final mission
Complete it — the trophy pops at the end

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts across Leonida. There are 397 in total — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge runs, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and only 250 are needed for the trophy (300 for 100%). Under-the-bridge runs are the quickest to farm: fly or drive under the marked bridges.
steps: Chase the stunt icons on the map — bridges first, they are the fastest
Any vehicle works; fast bikes and planes cover ground quickest
250 of 397 is enough — you can skip the hardest jumps

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Every range has several challenges, and the gold threshold for each is shown in-game at the range. This is also required in full for 100% completion, so there is no way around it.
steps: Visit all 12 shooting ranges and try each challenge
Learn the gold threshold for each challenge, then repeat until you clear it
Use the weapon the challenge asks for — switching weapons wastes attempts

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only some stranger strands count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not. More strands may still be undiscovered, so keep taking stranger missions as they appear.
steps: Take every stranger mission icon you see on the map
Finish full strands, not single missions — only completed strands count
Confirmed counting strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape (8 exist; all 8 are needed for 100%). Vaults open with an optional Chapter 4 mission, and every vault job brings a 4-star wanted level. Follow a security van, wait for it to stop at a large bank, then break in while the vault is open and escape on a fast bike.
steps: Unlock vaults with the Chapter 4 optional mission “That's Where The Money Is…”
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani ($10,000 each, after his earlier quests)
Follow the van, enter when the guard opens the vault, grab the cash and escape — then switch vehicles to lose the heat

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets holding 480 cards in total, and only 3 full sets are needed for the trophy (15 for 100%). Cards are scattered across Leonida; each set has 18–36 cards, and some cards have duplicates in several spots.
steps: Pick up cards as you explore — they count toward the set automatically
Focus on finishing any 3 sets rather than spreading across all 18
Track sets under Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app — any mix of the 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags. Walk on foot near a scannable spot and the phone prompts you to scan it. It counts toward the 100% checklist too.
steps: Walk on foot with the phone ready — scans only trigger off-vehicle
Scan everything the app flags: landmarks, curiosities, sculptures, tags
Track progress under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, races (car races, race challenges or drone races) and stunts. One try each is enough — no wins or scores needed.
steps: Work down the list: fish once, hunt once, play a hole of golf, try a range, shoot a game of pool, shoot hoops, play an arcade game, enter a race, pull a stunt

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races at 20 of the 40 unique race locations. Repeating a race you already won does not count — each win must be at a new location.
steps: Open the map and pick race locations you have not won at
Win at 20 different spots — repeats are wasted effort
Car races, bike races and other race types all count

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Winning one race per location is enough for the trophy; all 42 races are needed for 100%.
steps: Visit each of the 14 drone race locations
Win at least one race at each — learn the course first, then push for the win
All 42 races (3 per location) are needed later for 100%

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission; follow his fishing questline and beat him when the challenge comes up.
steps: Play through Chapter 1 until Cal texts you
Follow his fishing questline
Win the fishing challenge against him

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — all levels, once. There are four “Video Games”: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the home TV, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines.
steps: Pick any of the four games
Play through all of its levels once
Home TV games count the same as arcade machines

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: one meditation is offered only in Chapter 1 at Jason's house — after the mission “Down to Earth”, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks to the balcony; follow her and choose “Accept”. It disappears permanently after Chapter 1. It is not confirmed whether that Chapter 1 meditation is actually required for the trophy, so do it to be safe. The last meditation needs both characters together.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — after “Down to Earth”, follow Lucia to the balcony and accept the meditation (do this before Chapter 1 ends)
Find the other meditation spots across Leonida's 10 locations
The final spot needs Jason and Lucia together (available after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges out of 80. There are 8 categories with 10 challenges each; 70 are needed for 100%. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more — check the list in-game and pick the easiest 50.
steps: Open the Challenges list in-game
Clear the easiest 50 across the 8 categories
70 of 80 are needed later for 100%

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. You need both characters together, which is possible after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”. It often unlocks naturally during bank vault robberies, which always bring 4 stars.
steps: Play with your partner after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”
Get a 4-star wanted level — a bank vault robbery is the natural way
Escape: fast bike through traffic, then switch vehicles to go anonymous

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work best, after Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The unlock is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop.
steps: Bring your partner (after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”)
Rob the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City one after another
Keep your wanted level through all three — the trophy pops about 30 seconds after the third

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for the trophy. All 39 operations are needed for 100%. Operations are marked by yellow icons when you enter their location; loot all key valuables at each.
steps: Find Illegal Operations (yellow map icons at their locations)
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs
All 39 are needed later for 100% — loot every key valuable

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming). Fill Focus first with food or Adrenaline, use an assault rifle, and pick a spot with grouped enemies — gang operations work well. It does not work on soldiers, police or civilians, and is easier at Focus level 4.
steps: Fill your Focus meter (food, Adrenaline)
Find a group of gang enemies — an Illegal Operation is ideal
Trigger Combat Focus (L3+R3) and drop 5 in one use

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun from Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: enter through the back door, find the safe code note, and slip out unseen.
steps: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3)
Enter the jewelry store via the back door
Find the safe code note, open the safe, leave without being spotted

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission “That's Where The Money Is…”, and a bank vault job also counts. You can also do it early by sticky-bombing a truck's back door.
steps: Easiest: play the Chapter 4 optional mission “That's Where The Money Is…”
Or sticky-bomb an armored truck's back door and grab the cash
Escape the wanted level after the robbery

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. A plane is the fastest way to cover the state, flying over every region until no fog remains.
steps: Get a plane and fly a grid over the whole state
Watch the map unfog region by region
Mop up any fogged corners on foot or by car

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app. There are 557 vehicles at launch; 200 of the 277 base models are needed for 100%.
steps: Scan every new vehicle you see with the WAiNK app
100 discoveries is enough for the trophy
200 of 277 base models are needed later for 100%

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts (running total). You need the Dye Pack Jammer from Chapter 3 “Credit Check” first; Yasmani pays the most for marked bills.
steps: Unlock the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3 “Credit Check”
Collect marked bills from banks and payday loans
Fence them through your contacts — Yasmani pays best — until $250,000

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (running total). Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest ways to spend it.
steps: Buy guns, car mods and tattoos — the big-ticket items
Spending counts across every shop
It is a running total, so it adds up over the whole game

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties for sale (about $160,000 in total; the 4 story garages do not count). They are sold through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after Chapter 2 “Daily Driver”.
steps: Finish Chapter 2 “Daily Driver” to unlock the Real Estate app
Buy all 8 garages for sale (about $160,000 total)
Story garages do not count toward this

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses runs it after Chapter 2; you need free garage space, so register cheap cars and bikes to keep costs down.
steps: Unlock the Scooter Bros app with Moses (after Chapter 2)
Keep free garage space
Register 10 cheap cars or bikes

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the first mission, “Gone Fishing”, in Chapter 1. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends, and it cannot be missed.
steps: Play the opening mission “Gone Fishing” to the end

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Automatic story trophy — it pops when the chapter's last mission ends.
steps: Play through every Chapter 1 mission

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Automatic story trophy — it pops when the chapter's last mission ends.
steps: Play through every Chapter 2 mission

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Automatic story trophy — it pops when the chapter's last mission ends.
steps: Play through every Chapter 3 mission

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy — it pops when the chapter's last mission ends.
steps: Play through every Chapter 4 mission

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “Breakfast Run” in Chapter 2. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play “Breakfast Run” (Chapter 2) to the end

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “The Cartel Heist” in Chapter 3. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play “The Cartel Heist” (Chapter 3) to the end

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “Child's Play” in Chapter 4. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play “Child's Play” (Chapter 4) to the end

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “Headliners” in Chapter 4. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play “Headliners” (Chapter 4) to the end

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “VCIA Takedown” in Chapter 4. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play “VCIA Takedown” (Chapter 4) to the end

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission “Operation Savage Glory” in Chapter 5. Automatic — it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Play “Operation Savage Glory” (Chapter 5) to the end

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Her questline is Lucia-only, 5 quests, starting in Chapter 3 in Belville. It stays available after the story.
steps: Start Andy's quests in Belville (Chapter 3, Lucia only)
Complete all 5 quests
Finish her final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His treasure-diving questline covers 7 shipwrecks; it is marked in Chapter 1, goes temporarily unavailable during Chapter 1, and returns in Chapters 2–3. Everything stays available after the story.
steps: Meet Kenton (marked in Chapter 1)
Dive the shipwrecks he marks — 7 in total
Finish his final mission (available from Chapters 2–3 onward)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His 5 quests run from the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”. They stay available after the story.
steps: Head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County (after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”)
Complete Billy's 5 quests
Finish his final mission

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. “Randy's Wish List” asks you to deliver 16 sports cars; it starts in Chapter 3 after “Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS”. The cars he wants also pay very well, which helps the $200,000 vehicles-fenced requirement for 100%.
steps: Start “Randy's Wish List” in Chapter 3 (after “Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS”)
Deliver the 16 sports cars he wants
Finish his final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Jason-only: destroy the Synthetic Labs, then “Spin On This”. It starts in Chapter 3 after “Here, Kitty Kitty”.
steps: Start Tyrone's quests in Chapter 3 (after “Here, Kitty Kitty”, Jason only)
Destroy the Synthetic Labs
Finish “Spin On This”

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His Jason-only hunting questline starts after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break”, and his 15 Target Decks are all needed for 100%. NOTE: the exact animal that triggers this trophy is not yet confirmed by the guide sites — do not treat any single animal as the answer; work through Bret's hunting quests and the trophy will come with the unique hunt.
steps: Start Bret's hunting questline after Chapter 2 “Coffee Break” (Jason only)
Work through his Target Decks — all 15 are needed for 100% anyway
The unique-animal hunt that triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed by the guide sites

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal (E3/E4 are easiest), take off and fly about 1 km away.
steps: Go to VCIA and find a large passenger plane at a departure terminal (E3/E4 are easiest)
Board it and take off
Fly about 1 km away from the airport

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: “Kinda hot in these Rhinos.” Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station (south-west island, Mariana County) and shoot enemies from it.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in south-west Mariana County
Steal a Rhino tank
Shoot enemies from the tank

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. NOTE: no guide site has found the method for this trophy yet — it is listed as unknown by both PowerPyx and GTA-Zone. Do not chase rumoured methods; check back once a method is confirmed.
steps: No confirmed method exists yet — the guide sites list this trophy as unknown

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx reports this method: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City (needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3) and drive it through the window. NOTE: GTA-Zone still lists this as unconfirmed — a single source, so treat it as a lead, not a fact.
steps: Get the Key Cloner (Chapter 3)
Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City
Drive it through the showroom window
Single-source method — GTA-Zone has not confirmed it yet

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn: take all 3 key valuables — the luxury watch, the “Gutterball Moreland 850” shotgun, and the office safe (sticky bombs) — then escape the police. Not missable: the robbery icon respawns.
steps: Go to the Kingpin Bowling operation in Port Gellhorn
Take the luxury watch, the “Gutterball Moreland 850” shotgun and the office safe
Escape the police

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time — work out together, with gym memberships across Vice City.
steps: Get gym memberships for both characters
Work out together until both reach maximum Strength

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the trophy list tracks the count, so turn on Criminal Profile HUD notifications to watch it climb. Avoid the permanent “Irredeemable” profile.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile HUD notifications
Keep making profile-affecting choices — the count tracks to 500
Avoid actions that push the profile to permanent “Irredeemable”

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. NOTE: no guide site has found the method for this trophy yet. It is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but that is unconfirmed — do not treat it as fact.
steps: No confirmed method exists yet — the Payday Loans link is a guess, not a fact

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? PowerPyx reports a UFO easter egg: on the road north-west of Starlet Motel (Kelly County), at night after 2AM, solo — find the blinking car, follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, help the abducted woman, then return to her car. The spawn is random. NOTE: GTA-Zone still lists this as unconfirmed — a single source, so treat it as a lead, not a fact.
steps: Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel (Kelly County), at night after 2AM, alone
Find the blinking car and follow the path into the woods
Approach the UFO, help the abducted woman, return to her car
The spawn is random — single-source method, GTA-Zone has not confirmed it yet

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. NOTE: no guide site has found the method for this trophy yet. Kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle is a guess, unconfirmed — do not treat it as fact.
steps: No confirmed method exists yet — the motorcycle-kick theory is a guess, not a fact
